Hi all —

Short technical note on the capacity/latency tradeoffs Lisa asked about: 

- For sustained 5M tokens/month (avg concurrency spread), Recommended configuration: Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) sized for baseline throughput + autoscale for burst windows. This typically reduces per-token execution time variance and unlocks quantized model options that bring unit costs down.
- Expected 95th pct latency: ~220–320ms depending on prompt length and model family. With small prompt engineering and prefix caching we get toward the low end.
- Impact on cost: moving to Dedicated unlocks the ~$200 per 1M token scenario in Marissa's table once you commit to a monthly reserved capacity and enable quantized variants.

Happy to jump on the pricing review with your finance/econ buyer. Marissa — let me know who we'll add, and I can prep a one-slide technical appendix.

Thanks,
Connor
